country.evidence_quote: Emergency Rapid Deployment means we have teams of various professionals throughout the United States who are ready to deploy within 72 hours in the event of a natural disaster or crisis. In the past, it has meant anything from emergency unaccompanied minor care to Hurricane Harvey incident support. Today, it means helping to staff COVID-19 emergency shelters.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Endeavors® is a San Antonio nonprofit that serves vulnerable people in crisis through our innovative, personalized approach. Established in 1977, Endeavors’ Housing Program is its longest-running initiative. Its goal is to provide permanent supportive housing to female veterans, as well as individuals and families with mental illness and/or disabilities. Our Housing Services programs are located in San Antonio, Texas, and Fayetteville, North Carolina.
